answer: Vesting with clawback: every reward an agent earns is locked and released slowly over about 100 epochs, so a sybil operator must commit months of honest-looking work before any coin is spendable. If graders later flag an identity as a duplicate (copied answers, synced timing, shared funding), its unvested balance is clawed back and burned. Splitting into many fakes only multiplies locked exposure and drives their returns to a nadir. Fakes may wander between names, but every copper they earned stays chained to the address that earned it.
